cases.name: Travet Tivialle Simpson
cases.about: She was a project analyst at ZF Transmissions. A comment on her obituary said, "Words cannot express what I'm feeling! Travet had a heart of gold and tried to find the good in everyone! Travet had a laugh that would make you feel good! Travet was smart, very ambitious and loved her kids, family and friends! Travet I miss you my friend, my business partner and my SISTER! I will love you until the end of my time and beyond!!!! Our thoughts, prayers, and love are with the family. Sharon and Danny Smith"
